canDoYue: 你識改期限、調議程、話投影片唔好放意見，同埋問書面意見點處理。
canDoEn: Move a deadline, keep feedback off a slide, and ask what the agenda should say.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I would like to move the deadline, because the agenda still needs one more review before Friday.
dialogue.glossYue: 我想改期限，因為議程星期五之前仲要再睇一次。
dialogue.say: I would like to move the deadline, because the agenda still needs one more review before Friday.

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: We can move that review to next Monday, and I will add the point on the agenda.
dialogue.glossYue: 我哋可以將嗰次審閱搬去下星期一，我會加落議程。
dialogue.say: We can move that review to next Monday, and I will add the point on the agenda.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could we keep feedback off the first slide if the client has not read the brief yet?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果客戶未睇簡報，第一張投影片可唔可以先唔放意見？
dialogue.say: Could we keep feedback off the first slide if the client has not read the brief yet?

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: Yes. The first slide can stay as a short title until the client reads the full brief.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。第一張投影片可以保持短標題，等客戶睇完成份簡報。
dialogue.say: Yes. The first slide can stay as a short title until the client reads the full brief.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: What should the agenda say about our new deadline if we still owe them that written feedback?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果仲欠佢哋書面意見，議程應該點寫新期限？
dialogue.say: What should the agenda say about our new deadline if we still owe them that written feedback?

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: I will put the new date in the notes, and collect that written feedback after the meeting.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會喺筆記寫低新日期，會後收集嗰份書面意見。
dialogue.say: I will put the new date in the notes, and collect that written feedback after the meeting.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can the last slide show a new deadline without putting raw feedback on screen during the call?
dialogue.glossYue: 最後一張投影片可唔可以只顯示期限，通話畫面唔好放未整理嘅意見？
dialogue.say: Can the last slide show a new deadline without putting raw feedback on screen during the call?

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: That closing page will show the deadline only, and the raw notes stay inside our written pack.
dialogue.glossYue: 收結嗰頁只顯示期限，未整理嘅筆記留喺書面文件度。
dialogue.say: That closing page will show the deadline only, and the raw notes stay inside our written pack.
